title: REQ · The internal/execution package and handler are deleted
summary: backend/internal/execution with its handler and tests no longer exists.
description: Context: backend/internal/execution holds execution.go, handler.go and their tests, importing gitrepo and safepath. Desired behavior: the package is deleted entirely. Expected result: no execution package remains. Why: execution runs belong to development automation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when backend/internal/execution is stat'ed, then it does not exist.
Given gitrepo and safepath, when still imported by contribution and other packages, then they remain untouched.
